name: Hawk Shaw
source:
Hawk Shaw is a detective that [url=/c25366]Regeria[/url] interrogates in the courtroom.

[spoiler]He offers a bribe to Regeria to throw her case, and the player can choose whether to accept or not.[/spoiler]
